name: mediawiki-mcp
description: MediaWiki MCP server — search, read, and edit wiki pages over the REST and Action APIs, with optional multi-wiki support.

base_url.title: Wiki API Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your wiki (e.g. https://wiki.example.com). Used for the single-wiki setup. Leave blank only if you fill in the advanced Wikis list below instead.

username.title: Bot Username
username.description: Bot password username in User@BotName form (create one at Special:BotPasswords). Leave blank for anonymous read-only access. Applies to the single-wiki Base URL above.

password.title: Bot Password
password.description: The bot password generated at Special:BotPasswords. Required for editing. Stored in your OS keychain.

wikis.title: Wikis (advanced, multi-wiki)
wikis.description: Optional comma-separated Name:URL list for multiple wikis, e.g. Main:https://wiki.example.com,Dev:https://dev.example.com. If set, this takes precedence over the single Base URL above. Note: per-wiki bot credentials cannot be supplied through this one-click bundle — multi-wiki here is anonymous/read-only unless credentials are provided via environment variables (use the Docker/env setup for authenticated multi-wiki).

default_wiki.title: Default Wiki Name (advanced)
default_wiki.description: When using the multi-wiki list above, the name of the wiki to use when a tool call doesn't specify one (e.g. Main).
